At the Restaurant

Tom and Emily are celebrating their anniversary at The Maple Grill. Follow them from the front door to the check: listen to each part, answer the questions, and use the transcript only at the end.

7 parts About 5 min 23 questions American English
1Press play and listen to the whole part. Don’t worry about every word.
2Answer the questions. Use the colored lines on the bar to replay any sentence.
3When you finish, open the Transcript and check what you missed.
